en: overwhelmed by his own powerlessness.
zh: 被自己的無力感所淹沒。
ja: 自分の無力さに圧倒されていることに気づいた。
local: overwhelmed by his own powerlessness.
ja_pron: Jibun no muryoku-sa ni attō sarete iru koto ni kizuita.
native: overwhelmed by his own powerlessness.

en: Europe rolled towards war, the lights they went out, for an entire age darkness took hold.
zh: 歐洲走向戰爭，燈光熄滅，整個時代陷入黑暗。
ja: ヨーロッパは戦争へと進み、灯りは消え、暗黒の時代が訪れた。
local: Europe rolled towards war, the lights they went out, for an entire age darkness took hold.
ja_pron: Yōroppa wa sensō e to susumi, akari wa kie, ankoku no jidai ga otozureta.
native: Europe rolled towards war, the lights they went out, for an entire age darkness took hold.

en: On August 1, 1914, Kaiser Wilhelm II signed the mobilization order.
zh: 1914年8月1日，威廉二世皇帝簽署了動員令。
ja: 1914年8月1日、カイザー・ヴィルヘルム2世は動員命令に署名した。
local: On August 1, 1914, Kaiser Wilhelm II signed the mobilization order.
ja_pron: 1914-nen 8-gatsu 1-nichi, Kaizā Viruherumu nisei wa dōin meirei ni shomei shita.
native: On August 1, 1914, Kaiser Wilhelm II signed the mobilization order.

en: The Kaiser's sons now had to serve in the Prussian army.
zh: 皇帝的兒子們現在必須服役於普魯士軍隊。
ja: 皇帝の息子たちは今やプロイセン軍に従軍しなければならなかった。
local: The Kaiser's sons now had to serve in the Prussian army.
ja_pron: Kōtei no musuko-tachi wa imaya Puroisen-gun ni jūgun shinakereba naranakatta.
native: The Kaiser's sons now had to serve in the Prussian army.

en: Crown Prince Wilhelm received supreme command of the fifth, army, which was deployed on
zh: 皇太子威廉獲得了第五軍的最高指揮權，該軍部署於
ja: 皇太子ヴィルヘルムは第5軍の最高司令官に任命され、西部戦線に配備された。
local: Crown Prince Wilhelm received supreme command of the fifth, army, which was deployed on
ja_pron: Kōtaishi Viruherumu wa dai 5-gun no saikō shireikan ni ninmei sare, seibu sensen ni haibi sareta.
native: Crown Prince Wilhelm received supreme command of the fifth, army, which was deployed on

en: the western front.
zh: 西線前線。
ja: 西部戦線で。
local: the western front.
ja_pron: Seibu sensen de.
native: the western front.

en: What his father thought of his abilities, he personally let them know.
zh: 他父親對他的能力有何看法，他親自告訴了他們。
ja: 父親が彼の能力をどう思っていたかを、彼自身が伝えた。
local: What his father thought of his abilities, he personally let them know.
ja_pron: Chichioya ga kare no nōryoku o dō omotte ita ka o, kare jishin ga tsutaeta.
native: What his father thought of his abilities, he personally let them know.

en: Congrats on the win, achieved with God's help, he gave you the iron cross-second class.
zh: 恭喜你獲勝，這是神的幫助，他授予你二級鐵十字勳章。
ja: 神の助けを得て勝利を祝福し、彼はあなたに二級鉄十字章を授けた。
local: Congrats on the win, achieved with God's help, he gave you the iron cross-second class.
ja_pron: Kami no tasuke o ete shōri o shukufuku shi, kare wa anata ni nikyū tetsu jūjishō o sazuketa.
native: Congrats on the win, achieved with God's help, he gave you the iron cross-second class.

en: And first class, greet your brave troops with my thanks and that of the Fatherland.
zh: 還有一級勳章，向你勇敢的部隊致以我和祖國的感謝。
ja: そして一級も、勇敢な部隊に私と祖国からの感謝を伝えてくれ。
local: And first class, greet your brave troops with my thanks and that of the Fatherland.
ja_pron: Soshite ikkyū mo, yūkan na butai ni watashi to sokoku kara no kansha o tsutaete kure.
native: And first class, greet your brave troops with my thanks and that of the Fatherland.

en: While done, I am proud of you, your faithful Father Wilhelm.
zh: 任務完成，我為你感到驕傲，你忠誠的父親威廉。
ja: 任務を果たしたことを誇りに思う。忠実な父、ヴィルヘルムより。
local: While done, I am proud of you, your faithful Father Wilhelm.
ja_pron: Ninmu o hatashita koto o hokori ni omou. Chūjitsu na chichi, Viruherumu yori.
native: While done, I am proud of you, your faithful Father Wilhelm.

en: The other Kaiser's sons are also going to war.
zh: 其他皇帝的兒子們也參戰了。
ja: 他の皇帝の息子たちも戦争に赴いた。
local: The other Kaiser's sons are also going to war.
ja_pron: Hoka no kōtei no musuko-tachi mo sensō ni omomuita.
native: The other Kaiser's sons are also going to war.

en: Prince Eitel Friedrich and Prince Oscar led a regiment.
zh: 艾特爾·弗里德里希親王和奧斯卡親王率領一個團。
ja: アイテル・フリードリヒ王子とオスカー王子は連隊を率いた。
local: Prince Eitel Friedrich and Prince Oscar led a regiment.
ja_pron: Aiteru Furīdorihi ōji to Osukā ōji wa rentai o hikiita.
native: Prince Eitel Friedrich and Prince Oscar led a regiment.

en: The third Kaiser's son, Adalbert, became an officer on a battleship.
zh: 第三個皇帝的兒子阿達爾伯特成為戰艦上的軍官。
ja: 三男アダルベルト王子は戦艦の士官となった。
local: The third Kaiser's son, Adalbert, became an officer on a battleship.
ja_pron: Sannan Adaruberuto ōji wa senkan no shikan to natta.
native: The third Kaiser's son, Adalbert, became an officer on a battleship.

en: Only one stood out as an exception.
zh: 只有一人例外突出。
ja: ただ一人、例外として目立った者がいた。
local: Only one stood out as an exception.
ja_pron: Tada hitori, reigai to shite medatta mono ga ita.
native: Only one stood out as an exception.

en: Prince August Wilhelm was considered an esthete.
zh: 奧古斯特·威廉親王被認為是個唯美主義者。
ja: アウグスト・ヴィルヘルム王子は美学者と見なされていた。
local: Prince August Wilhelm was considered an esthete.
ja_pron: Augusuto Viruherumu ōji wa bigakusha to minasarete ita.
native: Prince August Wilhelm was considered an esthete.

en: He, described more like a tourist, was often seen around the battlefields, rather than
zh: 他更像個遊客，經常出現在戰場周圍，而不是
ja: 彼は観光客のように描写され、戦場の周りによく見られたが、
local: He, described more like a tourist, was often seen around the battlefields, rather than
ja_pron: Kare wa kankōkyaku no yō ni byōsha sare, senjō no mawari ni yoku mirarareta ga,
native: He, described more like a tourist, was often seen around the battlefields, rather than

en: actually taking on military responsibilities.
zh: 真正承擔軍事責任。
ja: 実際に軍事的責任を負うことはなかった。
local: actually taking on military responsibilities.
ja_pron: Jissai ni gunjiteki sekinin o ou koto wa nakatta.
native: actually taking on military responsibilities.

en: Throughout the war, his primary duties revolved around capturing photographs and crafting
zh: 整個戰爭期間，他的主要職責是拍攝照片和創作
ja: 戦争中、彼の主な任務は写真撮影と詩作に関わっていた。
local: Throughout the war, his primary duties revolved around capturing photographs and crafting
ja_pron: Sensō-chū, kare no omona ninmu wa shashin satsuei to shisaku ni kakawatte ita.
native: Throughout the war, his primary duties revolved around capturing photographs and crafting

en: melancholic poems.
zh: 憂鬱的詩歌。
ja: 憂鬱な詩を作ることだった。
local: melancholic poems.
ja_pron: Yūutsu na shi o tsukuru koto datta.
native: melancholic poems.

en: When the calamity could no longer be denied in the fall of 1918, when hunger, war weariness,
zh: 當1918年秋天災難無法再被否認，當飢餓、戰爭疲憊、
ja: 1918年秋、飢餓や戦争疲労が否定できなくなった時、
local: When the calamity could no longer be denied in the fall of 1918, when hunger, war weariness,
ja_pron: 1918-nen aki, kiga ya sensō hirō ga hitei dekinaku natta toki,
native: When the calamity could no longer be denied in the fall of 1918, when hunger, war weariness,

en: and uprising shook the country, the revolution broke out in Germany.
zh: 以及起義動搖了國家，革命在德國爆發。
ja: そして蜂起が国を揺るがし、ドイツで革命が勃発した。
local: and uprising shook the country, the revolution broke out in Germany.
ja_pron: Soshite hōki ga kuni o yurugashi, Doitsu de kakumei ga boppatsu shita.
native: and uprising shook the country, the revolution broke out in Germany.

en: On November 9th, Reich Chancellor Prince Max of Baden acted on his own.
zh: 11月9日，巴登的帝國總理馬克斯親王自行行動。
ja: 11月9日、バーデンの帝国宰相マックス王子は独断で行動した。
local: On November 9th, Reich Chancellor Prince Max of Baden acted on his own.
ja_pron: 11-gatsu 9-nichi, Bāden no teikoku saishō Makkusu ōji wa dokudan de kōdō shita.
native: On November 9th, Reich Chancellor Prince Max of Baden acted on his own.

en: He announced the application of Wilhelm II.
zh: 他宣布了威廉二世的退位申請。
ja: 彼はヴィルヘルム2世の退位を発表した。
local: He announced the application of Wilhelm II.
ja_pron: Kare wa Viruherumu nisei no taii o happyō shita.
native: He announced the application of Wilhelm II.

en: Without his knowledge, without his approval.
zh: 未經他知情，未經他批准。
ja: 彼の知らないうちに、彼の承認なしに。
local: Without his knowledge, without his approval.
ja_pron: Kare no shiranai uchi ni, kare no shōnin nashi ni.
native: Without his knowledge, without his approval.

en: It was a desperate attempt to signal a significant shift to the Allies.
zh: 這是向盟軍發出重大轉變信號的絕望嘗試。
ja: それは連合国に対する重要な変化を示す必死の試みだった。
local: It was a desperate attempt to signal a significant shift to the Allies.
ja_pron: Sore wa rengōkoku ni taisuru jūyō na henka o shimesu hisshi no kokoromi datta.
native: It was a desperate attempt to signal a significant shift to the Allies.

en: But it was a fallacy.
zh: 但這是一個錯誤。
ja: しかし、それは誤りだった。
local: But it was a fallacy.
ja_pron: Shikashi, sore wa ayamari datta.
native: But it was a fallacy.

en: On November 28th, the former emperor finally bowed to the inevitable.
zh: 11月28日，前皇帝終於屈服於不可避免的命運。
ja: 11月28日、元皇帝はついに避けられない運命に屈した。
local: On November 28th, the former emperor finally bowed to the inevitable.
ja_pron: 11-gatsu 28-nichi, moto kōtei wa tsuini sakerarenai unmei ni kusshita.
native: On November 28th, the former emperor finally bowed to the inevitable.

en: In Amherongen, while living in Dutch exile, Wilhelm II signed his abdication.
zh: 在阿姆赫倫根，威廉二世在荷蘭流亡期間簽署了退位書。
ja: アムヘロンゲンで、オランダ亡命中のヴィルヘルム2世は退位に署名した。
local: In Amherongen, while living in Dutch exile, Wilhelm II signed his abdication.
ja_pron: Amuherongen de, Oranda bōmei-chū no Viruherumu nisei wa taii ni shomei shita.
native: In Amherongen, while living in Dutch exile, Wilhelm II signed his abdication.

en: An empire had fallen, and with it, a man who truly believed he was upheld by divine right.
zh: 一個帝國已經倒下，與之同時，一個真正相信自己受神權支持的人也倒下了。
ja: 帝国は崩壊し、それと共に神権によって支えられていると信じていた男も倒れた。
local: An empire had fallen, and with it, a man who truly believed he was upheld by divine right.
ja_pron: Teikoku wa hōkai shi, sore to tomo ni shinken ni yotte sasaerarete iru to shinjite ita otoko mo taoreta.
native: An empire had fallen, and with it, a man who truly believed he was upheld by divine right.

en: After the end of the monarchy, a world collapsed for the emperor's children.
zh: 君主制結束後，皇帝的孩子們的世界崩潰了。
ja: 君主制の終焉後、皇帝の子供たちの世界は崩れた。
local: After the end of the monarchy, a world collapsed for the emperor's children.
ja_pron: Kunshusei no shūen-go, kōtei no kodomotachi no sekai wa kuzureta.
native: After the end of the monarchy, a world collapsed for the emperor's children.

en: The courtly life, their core existence vanished suddenly.
zh: 宮廷生活，他們的核心存在突然消失。
ja: 宮廷生活、彼らの中心的な存在が突然消えた。
local: The courtly life, their core existence vanished suddenly.
ja_pron: Kyūtei seikatsu, karera no chūshinteki na sonzai ga totsuzen kieta.
native: The courtly life, their core existence vanished suddenly.

en: Prince August Wilhelm was deeply shaken and sought refuge in a military hospital.
zh: 奧古斯特·威廉親王深受震撼，尋求在軍事醫院避難。
ja: アウグスト・ヴィルヘルム王子は深く動揺し、軍病院に避難した。
local: Prince August Wilhelm was deeply shaken and sought refuge in a military hospital.
ja_pron: Augusuto Viruherumu ōji wa fukaku dōyō shi, gunbyōin ni hinan shita.
native: Prince August Wilhelm was deeply shaken and sought refuge in a military hospital.

en: When he observed the emperor's portrait being taken down, he broke into tears and found
zh: 當他看到皇帝的肖像被撤下時，他淚流滿面，覺得

local: When he observed the emperor's portrait being taken down, he broke into tears and found
ja_pron: Kōtei no shōzō ga torihazusareru no o mite, kare wa namida o nagashi, kanjita.
native: When he observed the emperor's portrait being taken down, he broke into tears and found

en: it nearly impossible to accept the new reality.
zh: 幾乎無法接受新的現實。
ja: 新しい現実を受け入れることがほとんど不可能だと。
local: it nearly impossible to accept the new reality.
ja_pron: Atarashii genjitsu o ukeireru koto ga hotondo fukanō da to.
native: it nearly impossible to accept the new reality.

en: His marriage with Alexandra also crumbled shortly after, because the arranged union couldn't
zh: 他與亞歷山德拉的婚姻也很快破裂，因為這段安排的婚姻無法
ja: 彼のアレクサンドラとの結婚も間もなく崩壊した。なぜなら取り決められた結婚は

ja_pron: Kare no Arekusandora to no kekkon mo mamonaku hōkai shita. Nazenara torikimera reta kekkon wa
native: His marriage with Alexandra also crumbled shortly after, because the arranged union couldn't

en: hold together without the monarchy.
zh: 沒有君主制就無法維繫。
ja: 君主制なしでは維持できなかったからだ。
local: hold together without the monarchy.
ja_pron: Kunshusei nashi de wa iji dekinakatta kara da.
native: hold together without the monarchy.

en: All of this plunged Prince Alfie into a deep personal crisis.
zh: 這一切使阿爾菲親王陷入深刻的個人危機。
ja: これらすべてがアルフィー王子を深い個人的危機に陥れた。
local: All of this plunged Prince Alfie into a deep personal crisis.
ja_pron: Korera subete ga Arufī ōji o fukai kojinteki kiki ni ochiireta.
native: All of this plunged Prince Alfie into a deep personal crisis.

en: The marriages of idol Friedrich and the youngest son Prince Joachim also fell apart after
zh: 偶像弗里德里希和最小的兒子約阿希姆的婚姻也在革命後破裂。
ja: アイドルのフリードリヒと末っ子のヨアヒム王子の結婚も革命後に崩壊した。
local: The marriages of idol Friedrich and the youngest son Prince Joachim also fell apart after

native: The marriages of idol Friedrich and the youngest son Prince Joachim also fell apart after

zh: 革命之後。
ja: 革命の後に。
local: the revolution.
ja_pron: Kakumei no ato ni.
native: the revolution.

en: Prince Joachim committed suicide.
zh: 約阿希姆親王自殺了。
ja: ヨアヒム王子は自殺した。
local: Prince Joachim committed suicide.
ja_pron: Yoahimu ōji wa jisatsu shita.
native: Prince Joachim committed suicide.

en: Prince August Wilhelm's brother Wilhelm also faced difficult challenges after the revolution.
zh: 奧古斯特·威廉親王的兄弟威廉在革命後也面臨艱難挑戰。
ja: アウグスト・ヴィルヘルム王子の兄ウィルヘルムも革命後に困難な挑戦に直面した。
local: Prince August Wilhelm's brother Wilhelm also faced difficult challenges after the revolution.
ja_pron: Augusuto Viruherumu ōji no ani Wiruherumu mo kakumei-go ni konnan na chōsen ni chokumen shita.
native: Prince August Wilhelm's brother Wilhelm also faced difficult challenges after the revolution.

en: He lived on the island of Virengen in the Netherlands, in rather modest circumstances,
zh: 他住在荷蘭的維倫根島，生活相當簡樸，
ja: 彼はオランダのヴィレンゲン島で、かなり質素な環境で暮らしていた。
local: He lived on the island of Virengen in the Netherlands, in rather modest circumstances,
ja_pron: Kare wa Oranda no Virengen-tō de, kanari shisso na kankyō de kurashite ita.
native: He lived on the island of Virengen in the Netherlands, in rather modest circumstances,

zh: 在一個小漁村，佔據了一棟廢棄牧師館的兩個房間。
ja: 小さな元漁村に住み、廃墟となった牧師館の2部屋を占有していた。
local: in a small former fishing village, and occupied two rooms in an abandoned parsanage.

native: in a small former fishing village, and occupied two rooms in an abandoned parsanage.

en: It was the low point of his life with the abdication of his person from the throne.
zh: 這是他人生的低谷，因為他退位了。
ja: それは彼の人生のどん底であり、王位からの退位によるものだった。
local: It was the low point of his life with the abdication of his person from the throne.
ja_pron: Sore wa kare no jinsei no donzoko de ari, ōi kara no taii ni yoru mono datta.
native: It was the low point of his life with the abdication of his person from the throne.

en: Only in 1923 was he allowed to return to Germany.
zh: 直到1923年他才被允許返回德國。
ja: 1923年になってようやくドイツに戻ることが許された。
local: Only in 1923 was he allowed to return to Germany.
ja_pron: 1923-nen ni natte yōyaku Doitsu ni modoru koto ga yurusareta.
native: Only in 1923 was he allowed to return to Germany.

zh: 這與返回必須秘密進行的條件有關，
ja: これは帰国ができるだけ秘密裏に、

ja: そして何よりも政治的な目立った存在なしに行われるという条件に結びついていた。
local: possible, and above all, without any political prominence.
ja_pron: Soshite nani yori mo seijiteki na medatta sonzai nashi ni okonawareru to iu jōken ni musubitsuite ita.
native: possible, and above all, without any political prominence.

zh: 至少在1926年，親王家族的沒收在公投中被否決。
ja: 少なくとも1926年には、王族の財産没収は国民投票で否決された。
local: At least in 1926, the expropriation of the princely families was rejected in a popular
ja_pron: Sukunakutomo 1926-nen ni wa, ōzoku no zaisan bosshū wa kokumin tōhyō de hiketsu sareta.
native: At least in 1926, the expropriation of the princely families was rejected in a popular

en: referendum.
zh: 公投。
ja: 国民投票。
local: referendum.
ja_pron: Kokumin tōhyō.
native: referendum.

en: They got back a portion of their wealth.
zh: 他們拿回了部分財富。
ja: 彼らは財産の一部を取り戻した。
local: They got back a portion of their wealth.
ja_pron: Karera wa zaisan no ichibu o torimodoshita.
native: They got back a portion of their wealth.

en: Crown Princess Cecilia resided in one of Germany's most celebrated and historic Renaissance
zh: 皇太子妃塞西莉亞居住在德國最著名且具有歷史意義的文藝復興時期城堡之一，
ja: 皇太子妃セシリアはドイツで最も有名で歴史的なルネサンス期の城の一つに住んでいた。
local: Crown Princess Cecilia resided in one of Germany's most celebrated and historic Renaissance

native: Crown Princess Cecilia resided in one of Germany's most celebrated and historic Renaissance

en: castles.
zh: 城堡。
ja: 城。
local: castles.
ja_pron: Shiro.
native: castles.

en: Worlds Castle.
zh: 沃爾茨城堡。
ja: ヴォルツ城。
local: Worlds Castle.
ja_pron: Vorutsu-jō.
native: Worlds Castle.

en: In 1885, the castle came into the possession of the house of Hohen Solen and was transferred
